description: Mobile responsive layer. Creates src/components/MobileExploreTabs.tsx with role='tablist', roving tabindex (active=0, inactive=-1), Option-A aria-controls-on-active-only (iteration-3 MEDIUM #2), two independent auto-switch latches gated by requestKey (iteration-1 finding #8), keyboard navigation (Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Space), and `pb-20` content padding so the sticky bottom bar never covers content. Wires branching into Dashboard.tsx: `const isDesktop = useIsDesktop();` picks exactly one subtree — desktop grid or MobileExploreTabs — so the single <MapContainer> mount invariant is preserved (iteration-1 finding #1). Depends on FEAT-003 (needs the useIsDesktop module-scope hook, the Dashboard-level mapCard/inspectorStack/priorityCard regions, and the hoveredCellId prop pipeline).
steps: Create src/components/MobileExploreTabs.tsx as a `'use client';` component with props: `{ mapSlot: React.ReactNode; prioritySlot: React.ReactNode; inspectorSlot: React.ReactNode; selectedCell: RankedCell | null; scenario: ScenarioResult | null; requestKey: string; counts: { cells: number; scored: number; hasInspector: boolean } }`. Own `useState<"map"|"priority"|"inspector">("map")`. The component only mounts on narrow viewports (Dashboard decides via useIsDesktop) so tab state is discarded on resize to desktop — correct behaviour.

In MobileExploreTabs.tsx, render the content wrapper `<div className="pb-20">` containing `<div role="tabpanel" id={\`panel-${active}\`} aria-labelledby={\`tab-${active}\`} key={active} className="motion-safe:animate-fade-in">` with exactly one branch rendered: `{active === "map" && mapSlot}` / `{active === "priority" && prioritySlot}` / `{active === "inspector" && inspectorSlot}`. Only one branch mounted at a time preserves the single-MapContainer invariant.

Render the sticky bottom nav in MobileExploreTabs.tsx: `<nav role="tablist" aria-label="Dashboard view" className="fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-40 border-t border-[var(--line)] bg-[var(--color-surface-glass)] backdrop-blur-md shadow-[0_-8px_24px_rgba(39,65,43,0.08)] flex">`. Loop over `(["map","priority","inspector"] as const)`; for each tab render `<button key={id} type="button" role="tab" id={\`tab-${id}\`} {...(isActive ? { "aria-controls": \`panel-${id}\` } : {})} aria-selected={isActive} tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1} onClick={() => setActive(id)} className="min-h-11 min-w-11 flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 px-2 py-2 text-xs font-medium focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--green)] focus-visible:ring-offset-2">`. aria-controls on active tab ONLY (iteration-3 MEDIUM #2 Option A — the inactive `panel-${id}` is not in the DOM). Roving tabindex (active=0, others=-1). Inside each button: a small inline <svg> icon per tab (map pin / list / info) + a label text + an optional badge: 'Map' / 'Priority' + `counts.scored` badge if scored > 0 / 'Inspector' + a dot indicator when `counts.hasInspector`.

In MobileExploreTabs.tsx, implement keyboard navigation on the tab buttons: a shared `onKeyDown` handler on the tablist (or on each button) that maps ArrowLeft → previous tab (wrap), ArrowRight → next tab (wrap), Home → first tab, End → last tab, Enter/Space → activate current tab (equivalent to click). Moving between tabs with arrow keys SHOULD both update `active` state and set DOM focus to the new tab button (use a ref array keyed on tab id).

In MobileExploreTabs.tsx, add two independent auto-switch latches (iteration-1 finding #8): `const didAutoSwitchOnSelectRef = useRef(false); const didAutoSwitchOnProposeRef = useRef(false);`. Add a `useEffect` keyed on `[requestKey]` that resets both refs to `false` (new area restarts both latches). Add a `useEffect` keyed on `[selectedCell]`: `if (selectedCell && !didAutoSwitchOnSelectRef.current) { setActive("inspector"); didAutoSwitchOnSelectRef.current = true; }`. Add a parallel `useEffect` keyed on `[scenario]`: `if (scenario && !didAutoSwitchOnProposeRef.current) { setActive("inspector"); didAutoSwitchOnProposeRef.current = true; }`.

In src/components/Dashboard.tsx, extract three region variables above the return statement using the existing hooks and derived values (do NOT duplicate any logic): `const mapCard = (<section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-[32px] border border-white/80 bg-white shadow-[var(--shadow-glass-lg)]">{/* existing LayerDock + MapShell|LoadingSteps|error branch — unchanged */}</section>);` with the LayerDock inside being whichever mode matches the branch (desktop grid uses mode='floating'; the mobile branch may reuse the floating dock since the single mapSlot is a single section). `const inspectorStack = (<><ExploreGuide ... />{ready && ranking ? (<><ZoneDetails ... />{scenario && proposalCell && (<ImpactComparison ... />)}</>) : /* existing ready/error fallbacks */ null}</>);`. `const priorityCard = ready && ranking ? <PriorityPanel cells={cells} selectedCellId={selectedCellId} hoveredCellId={hoveredCellId} onSelectCell={selectCell} onHoverCell={setHoveredCellId} /> : null;`.

In Dashboard.tsx, compute `const isDesktop = useIsDesktop();` and branch the final return around it: `return (
{/* page summary row (already added in FEAT-003) */}{isDesktop ? (
{mapCard}{/* inline provenance footer */}
{inspectorStack}{priorityCard}
) : ()}
);`. NEVER render both branches simultaneously (iteration-1 finding #1 — critical invariant).

Confirm the single-mount invariant by inspection: `mapCard` is referenced exactly once in each branch, and the mobile branch wraps it inside MobileExploreTabs which only renders it when `active === "map"`. The LayerDock floating overlay sits inside `mapCard` and therefore follows the same single-mount lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` both exit 0 from the repo root.
src/components/MobileExploreTabs.tsx exists and exports a default or named `MobileExploreTabs` component with the described prop surface.
Only one subtree (desktop grid OR MobileExploreTabs) is rendered at any time — verified by code inspection of the branch in Dashboard.tsx.
The tablist in MobileExploreTabs uses roving tabindex (active=0, inactive=-1) and only the active tab carries `aria-controls` (iteration-3 MEDIUM #2 Option A).
Two independent refs gate the auto-switch to Inspector: first selection and first proposal fire exactly once each per requestKey; a new area resets both.
`git diff --stat src/lib src/types src/app/api` reports zero changes.
verification: cd "c:\\Users\\Daniyal\\Desktop\\New folder\\Alethiea" ; npm run typecheck ; npm run lint

Browser smoke at 375px: /explore shows a single stacked panel with a sticky bottom tab bar; tab buttons switch the visible panel; selecting a cell auto-switches to Inspector once, then stays on the tab the user picks; proposing 150m auto-switches once; changing area (navigate to '/' and back) resets both latches. Verify via DevTools that only one <div class="leaflet-container"> exists in the DOM at any time while switching tabs.
Browser smoke at 1280px: /explore renders the desktop two-column grid with no bottom tab bar; resizing across 768 flips cleanly.
